disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion for personal gain of an unnecessary drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, cure, or relieving of a human disease, ailment, defect, complaint, or other physical or mental condition, by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means, or offering, undertaking, attempting to do, or holding oneself out as able to do, any of these acts.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means the diagnosis, treatment, prevention, cure, or relieving of a human disease, ailment, defect, complaint, or other physical or mental condition, by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means, or offering, undertaking, attempting to do, or holding oneself out as able to do, any of these acts.

methods_authorized.quote: by attendance, advice, device, diagnostic test, or other means

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances in schedules 2-5. Telehealth prescribing is permitted when the health professional is acting within scope and meets applicable controlled substance requirements.
drug_authority.quote: It is the intent of the legislature to permit and facilitate adequate treatment for pain by licensed health professionals, including, but not limited to, the prescription or dispensing of controlled substances included in schedule 2 under section 7214, when medically appropriate

license_status_types.quote: A board may grant a limited license to an individual ... A board may grant the following types of limited licenses ... Educational ... Nonclinical ... Clinical academic

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates (outside US/Canada) may obtain a full license if they demonstrate: 10+ years of practice after completing degree requirements; 3+ years of postgraduate clinical training at an institution affiliated with a WHO-listed medical school; passing score on a board-approved initial medical licensure examination; and at least 2 years of safe and competent practice under a clinical academic limited license in Michigan (800+ hours/year). The board shall not impose requirements on foreign graduates exceeding those imposed on US/Canada graduates.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The board may grant a full license to practice medicine to an applicant who has completed the requirements for a degree in medicine at a medical school located outside the United States or Canada if ... the applicant has engaged in the practice of medicine for not less than 10 years after completing the requirements for a degree in medicine.

pain_management_education_required.quote: the board shall promulgate rules requiring each applicant for license renewal to complete as part of the continuing education requirement of subsection (1) an appropriate number of hours or courses in pain and symptom management.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Statute references section 7303a(4) and (5) as grounds for discipline and for issuance of a notification letter, indicating opioid prescribing limits exist in those sections. The board may promulgate rules describing circumstances under which a bona fide prescriber-patient relationship is not required for prescribing schedule 2-5 controlled substances.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A health professional providing telehealth services may prescribe drugs, including controlled substances, if acting within scope of practice and meeting applicable controlled substance requirements. The health professional must provide referrals if medically necessary and must make themselves available for follow-up care.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A health professional who is providing a telehealth service to a patient may prescribe the patient a drug if both of the following are met: (a) The health professional is a prescriber who is acting within the scope of his or her practice in prescribing the drug. (b) If the health professional is prescribing a drug that is a controlled substance, the health professional meets the requirements of this act applicable to that health professional for prescribing a controlled substance.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A health professional shall not provide a telehealth service without directly or indirectly obtaining consent for treatment.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: An allopathic physician who holds an expedited license under the interstate medical licensure compact is authorized to engage in the practice of medicine under this article.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician's assistant shall not engage in the practice as a physician's assistant except under the terms of a practice agreement that meets the requirements of this section.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician's assistant who is a party to a practice agreement may prescribe drugs, including controlled substances in schedules 2-5, in accordance with department rules. The PA's name and DEA registration number must be indicated on controlled substance prescriptions.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician's assistant who is a party to a practice agreement may prescribe a drug in accordance with procedures and protocols for the prescription established by rule of the department in consultation with the appropriate board. A physician's assistant may prescribe a drug, including a controlled substance that is included in schedules 2 to 5 of part 72.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: If it receives information reported under section 16243(2) that indicates 3 or more malpractice settlements, awards, or judgments against a licensee in a period of 5 consecutive years or 1 or more malpractice settlements, awards, or judgments against a licensee totaling more than $200,000.00 in a period of 5 consecutive years, whether or not a judgment or award is stayed pending appeal, the department shall investigate.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A notice of revocation, suspension, or limitation of staff privileges or a change in employment status due to disciplinary action by a licensed health facility.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The health professional recovery committee is created in the department and shall consist of the following voting members

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: a disciplinary subcommittee or a hearings examiner or the department with the approval of a disciplinary subcommittee may require the applicant, licensee, or registrant to submit to a mental or physical examination conducted by physicians or other appropriate health professionals designated by the disciplinary subcommittee or the department.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: Nonclinical, to an individual who functions only in a nonclinical academic, research, or administrative setting and who does not hold himself or herself out to the public as being actively engaged in the practice of the health profession

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Except in the case of gross negligence or willful misconduct as determined by the department, a health care provider's recommendation or treatment provided as authorized under the right to try act is not grounds for the department to investigate under section 16221 or for disciplinary action against a licensee under section 16226.

scope__license_status_types.quote: An individual who is retired from engaging in the active practice of a health profession and who wishes to donate his or her expertise for the health care and treatment of indigent and needy individuals in this state ... may obtain a special volunteer license
A board may grant a nonrenewable, temporary license to an applicant who has completed all requirements for licensure except for examination or other required evaluation procedure.

A board may grant a limited license to an individual if the board determines that the limitation is consistent with the ability of the individual to practice the health profession in a safe and competent manner
As a condition of reinstatement, a board or task force shall place the licensee on probation for 1 year under conditions set by the board or task force.

After finding the existence of 1 or more of the grounds for disciplinary subcommittee action listed in section 16221, a disciplinary subcommittee shall impose 1 or more of the following sanctions for each violation: ... suspension

After finding the existence of 1 or more of the grounds for disciplinary subcommittee action listed in section 16221, a disciplinary subcommittee shall impose 1 or more of the following sanctions for each violation: ... revocation

The expiration or surrender of a license or registration does not terminate the board's authority to impose sanctions on the licensee or registrant whose license or registration has expired or been surrendered.

Clinical academic, to an individual who practices the health profession only as part of an academic institution and only in connection with his or her employment or other contractual relationship with that academic institution.

An individual who is retired from engaging in the active practice of a health profession and who wishes to donate his or her expertise for the health care and treatment of indigent and needy individuals in this state ... may obtain a special volunteer license
An allopathic physician who holds an expedited license under the interstate medical licensure compact is authorized to engage in the practice of medicine under this article.
A limited license for a postgraduate shall require that the individual confine his or her practice and training to a hospital or institution approved by the board for the training.
